findings.title: Preserve an explicit center-selection form across background session reads
findings.trigger: In an authenticated workspace, choose Change connection, enter a different address/token, then return focus to the page or receive a same-address BroadcastChannel session notification.
findings.evidence: The wake handler at1232/1237 and bus1239 invoke read. ConnectionSession.ready publishes a new identity object for a successful unchanged session. This effect depends on state.identity and unconditionally calls setSelecting(false), so ready becomes true and Connection unmounts even though no user connect/check-existing action occurred.
findings.impact: The center chooser closes and entered values are lost on an ordinary background observation; switching centers can be interrupted while editing.
findings.requestedChange: Keep explicit selection intent independent from successful background reads. Only an explicit successful connect/check-existing choice or another intentional navigation should close the chooser; preserve automatic initial/same-owner recovery and stale-generation guards.
findings.validation: Use actual mounted App with one authorized center: open chooser, enter candidate input, trigger successful background read, verify form and input remain. Then explicit Connect/Check existing must finish the intended flow without automatic business POST.
findings.basis: Source-proven state transition; no new browser reproduction during S01 exclusive window.

findings.title: Settle the steering receipt when the deadline expires during durable storage
findings.trigger: Current-generation steering remains authorized while recovery.prepare/dispatch or accepted checkpoint resolves after its timeout signal has fired.
findings.evidence: The added awaited storage barriers are followed by signal.aborted return paths. dispatch.finally clears this.sending, but the receipt remains phase:sending. retry only accepts unknown; restore rejects an existing sending receipt. updateGate cannot help because generation/authorization did not change.
findings.impact: The original-page receipt stays Sending with no legal retry or terminal reconciliation until reload, despite a settled durable record; this undermines the recovery path for slow storage.
findings.requestedChange: Handle current-generation deadline expiry as a settled recoverable outcome while retaining the exact key/input and distinguishing pre-HTTP from accepted durable checkpoints. Keep stale-generation callbacks unable to publish; do not auto-retry or downgrade an accepted journal record.
findings.validation: Deferred recovery prepare/dispatch across a controlled timeout must produce a retryable same-key receipt with0HTTP; a delayed accepted checkpoint must allow terminal reconciliation without a duplicate request. Verify auth-generation revocation still preserves unknown and ignores stale completion.
findings.basis: Source-proven current-generation timeout branch; no runtime or fake-timer execution by reviewer.
